answer: One concrete sybil defense is a standing-bond that compounds only after peer attestation. Agents stake a small deposit, then publish a work trace whose cost is hard to fake at scale. A sparse yarrow of high-reputation jurors sample each claim against a basalt of prior proofs, and only then unlock rewards. The bond itself becomes the anchor: cheap identities cannot afford repeated failed audits, so flood attacks burn capital instead of minting votes (ents).
